cases.input: Callback declaration order differs but unique labels/types/effects match.
cases.expected: Accept without forwarding wrapper.

cases.input: Callback has a renamed label or wider effects than admitted.
cases.expected: Reject before application execution.

cases.input: A different module constructs or updates a public opaque record.
cases.expected: Reject every representation bypass.

cases.input: Two locked dependencies export models.Report with identical fields.
cases.expected: Distinct nodes remain distinct nominal types; repeated aliases of one node unify.

cases.input: A package tries to supply std or host.
cases.expected: Resolution fails before execution.

cases.input: An effectful test has no fake for an admitted call.
cases.expected: Fail that isolated test; never use live fallback.

cases.input: A fake returns a value outside the declared result type.
cases.expected: Fail that isolated test and continue the suite.

cases.input: A test explicitly matches expected Result.Err.
cases.expected: Pass if its assertion matches; Err is not automatically a test fault.

cases.input: Generation timeout occurs while a tool is evaluating pure code.
cases.expected: Cancel and join local work before Timeout; no local instructions after return.

cases.input: Generation timeout interrupts nested tool maps and host reads.
cases.expected: Close admission, abandon waits, join local work; remote unknown charges remain.

cases.input: Tool fault is admitted before timeout in terminal event order.
cases.expected: Root-fatal outcome takes precedence; reproduce the recorded ordering.

cases.input: Caller recovers from Timeout and begins a new generation.
cases.expected: Old local continuation cannot execute or terminate the recovered run.

cases.input: Tool cleanup exceeds finite host allowance.
cases.expected: Terminate isolated worker with fatal CleanupFailure; never leak live local work behind Timeout.

cases.input: Transitive wrapper implementation changes with same symbol/schema.
cases.expected: Old-build authorization fails unless host policy authorizes new build.

cases.input: Unique private markers appear in input, validator errors and provider messages.
cases.expected: No markers in metadata-only persistence or default runtime diagnostics.

cases.input: Concurrent exported calls each request one allowed model invocation.
cases.expected: Require an explicit run/session rule before generated clients ship.

cases.input: Two pure branches compete for three remaining charges.
cases.expected: Logical outcome reproduced independently of physical timing or replay rejected as unsupported.

cases.input: Temporary allocations overlap under variable worker timing.
cases.expected: Deterministic logical allocation accounting; containment failures distinguished.

cases.input: Maintenance task introduces helper and updates callers.
cases.expected: Do not score until an authorized declaration/multi-file edit path is available.

cases.input: Recursive tree and reusable collection predicates exercise eligibility.
cases.expected: Compare bounded subset variants without claiming purity proves termination.

cases.input: A synthesis request fails after one completed read tool.
cases.expected: Keep current no-retry rule unless narrow frozen-step retry experiment justifies amendment.
